mapper.sql: id, user_id, memory_type, mem_key, content, confidence, importance, source_conv_id, status, hit_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_memory (user_id, memory_type, mem_key, content, confidence, importance, source_conv_id, status, hit_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memKey}, #{content}, #{confidence}, #{importance}, #{sourceConvId}, 'ACTIVE', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_memory SET content = #{content}, memory_type = #{memoryType}, confidence = GREATEST(confidence, #{confidence}), importance = GREATEST(importance, #{importance}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mem_key = #{memKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qa_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY importance DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM qa_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY importance DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_memory SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN #{id}
UPDATE qa_memory SET content = #{content}, importance = #{importance}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}

UPDATE qa_memory SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id FROM qa_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY importance DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{keep} ) keep_rows )
